summary: Added a reversible Alembic/PostgreSQL foundation with one bounded foundation_proofs table, no seed DML, and credential-safe DATABASE_URL validation.

commands: DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg2://... alembic -c backend/alembic/alembic.ini upgrade head; alembic current; alembic downgrade base; alembic upgrade head; alembic heads (disposable local PostgreSQL 17)
PostgreSQL information_schema and pg_constraint inspection for public tables, column types/defaults/nullability, primary key, and check constraints
DATABASE_URL=postgres://... alembic -c backend/alembic/alembic.ini upgrade head --sql plus static seed-DML scan
DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///... alembic -c backend/alembic/alembic.ini upgrade head --sql (expected credential-safe rejection)
tests.notes: Upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade passed on a disposable PostgreSQL 17 database. The only public tables after upgrade were Alembic's own version table and foundation_proofs; downgrade removed foundation_proofs. Introspection confirmed VARCHAR(64) primary-key key, VARCHAR(256) nonempty value, seed_version >= 1, and timezone-aware created_at/updated_at CURRENT_TIMESTAMP defaults.

notes_for_next_agent: Backend reset/seed logic must remain application-owned DML and target only the stable foundation key; this schema migration intentionally contains no seed row.

No RLS was added because RAIL-001 uses private operator-token enforcement in the backend and Railway PostgreSQL rather than Supabase; later access-domain tasks own authorization schema/policy decisions.
